name: colloquy
description: Collaborate through a commentable HTML page on localhost: present plans, findings, and work in progress, then carry the reviewer's anchored feedback back into the session.

interface.shortDescription: Review agent work in a commentable local page.
interface.longDescription: Present plans, findings, and work in progress as a local HTML page with anchored comments, interactive decisions, and live revisions.
defaultPrompt: Present this work as a Colloquy page.
Use Colloquy for a reviewable plan.
